title: Appel à projets M-ERA.NET 2026/27 - Science et ingénierie des matériaux pour l'innovation en Europe (édition 2027 pour l'ANR)
official_source: Agence nationale de la recherche (ANR), pour le compte du consortium M-ERA.NET
duration: Maximum project duration is 3 years (36 months).
description: The M-ERA.NET Call 2026, the 2027 edition for the ANR, brings together more than 30 funding agencies to fund ambitious transnational research and innovation projects in advanced materials and battery technology supporting the European Green Deal and the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Partners of selected projects are funded directly by their own national or regional organisations, so national and regional eligibility rules apply in addition to those of the call.

title: AFdoc – Aides à la formation doctorale (FNR PhD funding scheme)
official_source: Fonds National de la Recherche (FNR), Luxembourg
duration: Funding may cover up to four years of doctoral training.
description: Following the entry into force of the new FNR law on 1 August 2026, the Luxembourg National Research Fund is launching AFdoc - Aides a la formation doctorale, a PhD funding scheme supporting talented doctoral candidates with a clear link to Luxembourg who undertake PhD projects in established research environments abroad or through collaborations involving Luxembourg-based R&D companies.

title: Flanders Trainee Programme (Flanders Traineeship Programme)
official_source: Government of Flanders — Flanders Trainee Programme (Departement Buitenlandse Zaken)
duration: The grant covers an internship of at least two and up to six months. The internship can be extended to a total duration of six months, or nine months where the internship concerns a project funded by the Government of Flanders.
description: The Flanders Trainee Programme gives young people who hold a secondary or higher education diploma obtained in Flanders financial support for an internship with a multilateral organisation. The grant is made up of a one-off travel allowance and a monthly lump-sum amount for accommodation and living expenses, both set in advance; the monthly amount depends on the host city. Nationality and official place of residence are irrelevant, and the programme targets people interested in global challenges such as climate change, food security or human rights. title: Estonian Scholarship Programme for international students, researchers and academic staff — Scholarship for degree and exchange study in Estonia
official_source: Estonian Education and Youth Board (Haridus- ja Noorteamet) and Estonian Ministry of Education and Research
duration: One academic year (2026/2027); scholarships are paid for undergraduate students for 12 months of the academic year, except for the final nominal year when the scholarship is paid for 10 months
description: A monthly stipend for foreign students who already hold an admission confirmation from an Estonian higher education institution for the 2026/2027 academic year. The rate is EUR 350 per month for first-cycle (BA) and master's studies and EUR 660 per month for doctoral studies. The Board pays the scholarship to the host university, which then disburses it. The scheme is funded under bilateral intergovernmental or inter-ministerial agreements and is run through the Estonian Scholarship Programme.

title: Nordic Scholarship Programme (Nordic Africa Institute)
duration: One-month stay at the Nordic Africa Institute in Uppsala
description: A one-month funded research stay at the Nordic Africa Institute in Uppsala for Africa-focused researchers and students already based at a university or research centre in Sweden, Finland, Denmark or Iceland. The scholarship covers return travel at the least expensive fare, free centrally located accommodation in Uppsala, a desk and computer in a shared office at the Institute, and a subsistence allowance of SEK 450 per day. It is a short-term research stay award, not a degree programme.
